image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a silver alloy car wheel mounted on a vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke design with a polished metallic finish. A black rubber tire surrounds the rim, showing visible tread patterns and sidewall details. The central hub contains five lug nuts arranged in a pentagonal pattern around a center cap. The background shows a portion of the car's body panel and a textured gray pavement surface.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify class alignment with high confidence.
To check for 'melting' or blurring at the critical boundary where the metal rim meets the rubber tire, a common AI artifact.
To verify that the spaces between the spokes reveal a consistent depth/background and do not suffer from structural collapse or impossible geometry.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the metal reflections or tire rubber that might indicate generative artifacts.

focus_areas: Symmetry of the 5-spoke design and lug nut placement
Sharpness of the boundary between the silver rim and black tire
Consistency of reflections on the metallic surface
Physical plausibility of the tire tread deformation against the ground
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the lug nuts; AI often generates asymmetric or fused bolts. Verify if the reflection on the rim matches the environment (pavement/car body). Check if the tire tread pattern degrades naturally or looks pasted on.
